verdict.rationale: Private service-to-service networking is a fair question for a cloud deployment platform that runs serverless functions and managed databases, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents private networking, internal-only endpoints, or traffic isolation between services. Automatic HTTPS, DDoS protection and Advanced Security are adjacent security features and do not keep internal traffic off the public internet.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can keep internal service-to-service traffic off the public internet without VPC complexity
